name: brief-slickedit-helpers
description: Small helper commands closing remaining gaps between SlickEdit's Brief emulation and the brief4vscode extension.

commands.title: Brief Helpers: Backspace (rubout - stop at column 1, never join previous line)
Brief Helpers: Zap Whitespace (delete whitespace run at cursor; no-op at end of line, fixing the SlickEdit hang)
Brief Helpers: Home (deterministic line/window/file tiers, no scroll drift)
Brief Helpers: End (deterministic line/window/file tiers, no scroll drift)
Brief Helpers: Up (character-index goal column, immune to glyph-width rendering drift)
Brief Helpers: Down (character-index goal column, immune to glyph-width rendering drift)
Brief Helpers: Write Comment Block
Brief Helpers: Write Section Separator
Brief Helpers: Write File Header
Brief Helpers: Write Function Block
Brief Helpers: Line Marking Mode Toggle (leaves the caret where it started, as SlickEdit does)
Brief Helpers: Column Marking Mode Toggle (own implementation: the block is what gets cut)
Brief Helpers: Column Marking: Cancel Block
Brief Helpers: Column Marking: Extend Block Up (keeps the marked columns over short/blank lines)
Brief Helpers: Column Marking: Extend Block Down (keeps the marked columns over short/blank lines)
Brief Helpers: Column Marking: Extend Block Left
Brief Helpers: Column Marking: Extend Block Right
Brief Helpers: Column Marking: Extend Block to Column 0
Brief Helpers: Column Marking: Extend Block to End of Line
Brief Helpers: Column Marking: Extend Block Up One Page
Brief Helpers: Column Marking: Extend Block Down One Page
Brief Helpers: Column Marking: Cut Block
Brief Helpers: Column Marking: Copy Block
Brief Helpers: Column Marking: Delete Block (no copy)

briefHelpers.reverseSingleLineMarkSelect.description: Alt+L line marking: while the marked block is a single line, reverse the selection so the caret shows on the marked line (at column 0) rather than at the start of the line after it. Same highlighted range either way. Set false for brief4vscode's original forward selection.
